summary: Frontend testing of PhiCor.ai Popular Foods section, Pro Tips, food click flow, and Quantity Calculator with real macros. All 5 requested test items PASS. Previous iteration_7 bugs (Scaled Macronutrients grid missing, Base/Adjusted inconsistency) are now FIXED.

test_results.popular_foods_section: PASS - Empty state on /food shows 'Popular Foods by Health Goal' with all 6 categories
test_results.categories: PASS - Heart Healthy (❤️), Brain Boosters (🧠), Energy Foods (⚡), Immunity Boosters (🛡️), Gut Health (🦠), Protein Rich (💪) all render with 5 food items each
test_results.popular_food_click: PASS - Clicking 'Salmon' in Heart Healthy triggers analyzeFood → loads 'Salmon, Atlantic, raw' analysis with Macronutrients, Clinical Summary, Organ System Effects
test_results.pro_tips_section: PASS - Pro Tips box with 4 hints renders below popular foods
test_results.quantity_calculator_2x: PASS - Search Salmon → Quantity → 2x shows Scaled Macronutrients grid: 301 kcal, 33.6g Protein, 17.6g Fat (base kcal=150.4, protein=16.8g → doubled correctly, ~300 kcal, ~34g protein as expected). Base badge '3 oz (85g)' consistent with Adjusted '170g' (85g × 2). ITERATION_7 BUGS FIXED.

critical_code_review_comments: FoodAnalysisPage.js is 3155+ lines - still exceeds 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into QuantityCalculatorPanel, PopularFoodsGrid, MacroSummary, OrganEffectsGrid modules.

Patient context badges on /differential and /drugs only render when a patient is selected in localStorage; not verified end-to-end here (no patient seeded). Code paths look correct per usePatient hook usage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On /food empty state, the Popular Foods grid has 6 category cards, each with clickable food buttons that call analyzeFood(). Quantity Calculator opens via data-testid='quantity-calculator-toggle'. The Scaled Macronutrients preview grid now correctly renders when servingMultiplier != 1, showing calories/protein/carbs/fat/fiber scaled from complete_nutritional_profile.macronutrients (energy_kcal, protein_g, etc). Base (e.g., '3 oz (85g)') and Adjusted grams (170g at 2x) are now consistent. For patient badge testing on /differential and /drugs, seed a patient in localStorage first.
